project_name: Telecanto Pizza - Online Ordering & Admin System
archetype: Modern Street Food & Urban Delivery (Light Theme, High-Vibrancy Magenta Accent)

responsive.layout: Single column scroll on mobile (<768px) with sticky top category navigation pill bar and floating/sticky bottom cart bar. On desktop (>=1024px), split grid with prominent category scroller, 3-column food grid, and side sticky cart drawer/sidebar.
responsive.typography: Fluid scaling with rem units. Large inputs on mobile (min 44px height, 16px font size to prevent iOS auto-zoom).
responsive.overflow_guard: Use overflow-x-hidden on body and max-w-full on all containers.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44x44px touch targets for all interactive buttons, radios, count adjustments, and toppings toggles.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the design remains strictly LIGHT THEME with clean white cards, soft slate borders (#E2E8F0), and vivid Telecanto Magenta (#E01E5A) for accents.
Do NOT use dark full-page backgrounds or vintage wood Italian patterns.
Highlight the Pickup option ('ΠΑΡΑΛΑΒΗ ΑΠΟ ΤΟ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΗΜΑ') prominently alongside Delivery ('DELIVERY'). Provide a toggle banner right at top of store front.

Build a 5-step checkout process: (1. Mode selection -> 2. Personal Details -> 3. Delivery Address / Store Pickup Point -> 4. Cash / IRIS Payment Selection -> 5. Confirmation & Live Order Status Tracker).
Include Cash and IRIS payments ONLY. Expressly indicate 'Χωρίς πιστωτική κάρτα / Card payments disabled'.
Implement the product customization modal with real-time price calculation (Size: Ατομική, Κανονική, Γίγας; Dough options; Extra toppings with price per topping; Special requests textarea).
Add test IDs (`data-testid`) to all key buttons, inputs, product items, cart elements, order status badges, and admin action elements.
Provide customer features: Login/Register modal or screen, Order History, Favorites heart toggle, Loyalty Points balance & redemption during checkout.

Build full Admin Dashboard: Today's Orders counter, Total Revenue, Popular items chart, Opening Hours toggle (Ανοιχτό / Κλειστό), Delivery Zone editor, CRUD for products/categories/offers, live audio/visual ping for new incoming orders.
